source_clause: PRWEL1.) Unless user has selected to turn off welcome popups, the Head Unit will display a “welcome” popup at ignition on and any time a Profile is activated.
leaf_desc_037: PRWEL1.) Unless user has selected to turn off welcome popups, the Head Unit will display a “welcome” popup at ignition on and any time a Profile is activated.
reasoning: 驗證目標：7.1（PRWEL1）—— 除非使用者關閉，welcome popup 於電門開啟時與任何 profile 被啟用時顯示。關鍵情境條件：兩個 profile 之設定皆為開啟，否則第二個觸發無從觀察。為什麼這樣切：本 leaf 之單位為**顯示之觸發**；popup 之內容屬 7.2／7.2.1，其清除屬 7.4。

tcs.tc_title: Welcome popup shown at ignition on and on activation
tcs.test_item:
Welcome popup shown at ignition on and on activation

(Verifies that a welcome popup is displayed at ignition on and each time a Profile is activated)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. Two Driver Profiles exist on the vehicle
2. The Welcome popup setting is on for both Profiles
3. The vehicle is stationary
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Switch the ignition on and read the screen
2. Activate Driver Profile B and read the screen
tcs.expected_result:
1. A welcome popup is displayed at ignition on
2. A welcome popup is displayed for Driver Profile B
tcs.priority_basis: welcome popup 之兩個觸發；ch7 之入口條文
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: **條文列兩個觸發**（`at ignition on` 與 `any time a Profile is activated`），依 §7 兩者皆須走到 —— 故本條兩步。`Unless user has selected to turn off welcome popups` 為適用條件（§8.7.3），以 pre-condition 固定為開啟；**關閉後不再顯示一側由 `SWE1-HMI-PROF-051`（6.3.2）承擔**。**X-1**：步驟 2 之切換所觸發者（5.3.1 之 PU0580）**即 ER2 所斷言者** —— 標的而非干擾。
